candidate: codex/core-logs-ci-performance working tree after the storage-policy presentation fix; exact source hashes below

scope.data: Synthetic loopback fixture, four engines; alpha/bravo/charlie scopes. Long messages repeat 80 times, short messages repeat zero times. Both versions use the same candidate HTTP fixture and pressure script; frontend product modules come from exact df1ad925 or the candidate working tree.
scope.backendLimitation: Fixture validators are synthetic and bypass body construction when unchanged. Production computes content SHA256 after permission checks and SQL/JSON work, so these results establish transport/browser savings, not lower database cost or production TTFB.
scope.byteDefinition: Encoded/decoded HTTP log response body bytes; excludes HTTP request/response headers and TLS framing. 304 still has headers. Synthetic failure response bodies are not instrumented by the fixture; byte comparisons refer to successful 200 log payloads and 304 responses.
scope.measurementDefinition: Timed step actions include two requestAnimationFrame turns after the relevant UI state. Initial visible/complete measurements use wall-clock waits for a visible row and the complete paused state. Changed refresh waits for the first displayed row key to change after server completion. Unchanged sampling waits for at least three fixture completions and three browser-consumed 200 bodies or 304 responses, then two frames before pausing and capturing the snapshot.
scope.bodyAndJSONMs: Includes body streaming, decompression and JSON parsing wait; not exclusive CPU parse time.
scope.cache: Short snapshots fit the 16 MiB cache and show 200 rows synchronously on return. Long 8000-entry snapshots exceed that budget and correctly show zero synchronous cached rows.
scope.sampling: One final observation per case/version after the storage-policy presentation fix, on a shared host; six browsers ran sequentially. These are not percentile guarantees. Earlier observations remain in output/playwright and are excluded from these case values. All attempted requests are retained. The accelerated 100 ms poll timer can start an additional request between the completion wait and snapshot: longGzip candidate unchanged has four attempts, three completed 304 polls and one in-flight attempt with no response/body recorded at sampling. Both shortPlain changed snapshots have two attempts and one completion. Incomplete records do not prove cancellation or eventual outcome.
scope.phaseAggregation: Phase calls are aggregated as calls/totalMs/maxMs per sampling window; phase durations may be nested and must not be summed as exclusive CPU time. Full per-call raw output for these observations remains in output/playwright/*-policy-final.txt; previous raw files are retained.
scope.requestCountDefinition: Summary fields named RequestCount count all attempted fixture GETs, including incomplete ones. CompletedRequestCount counts fixture response finishes at sampling; IncompleteRequestCount is their difference. Only completed polls are described as completed refreshes.
